intro: Gyno Knott Powder is an ayurvedic blend created to aid gallbladder and urinary wellness through supportive herbs that encourage bile flow, kidney health, and stone comfort. Consistent use alongside adequate hydration and a balanced diet may help maintain ease and promote natural cleansing pathways. Designed as a daily wellness supplement for adults; results vary by individual and routine. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

li: Ayurvedic wellness powder formulated to support comfort from gallstone‑related symptoms and maintain digestive bile flow.

Drink 2–3 liters of water daily unless advised otherwise by a professional.
